questions.question: In his letter to the Romans, Paul said God rejected His people Israel. True or false?
When Elijah said he was the only one left, what did God say about the seven thousand men He had reserved for Himself?

answers.text: They never bowed to the false god Baal
They hid all of God's true prophets
They rebuilt all of God's torn altars

questions.question: When the prophet Elijah told God that Israel had killed His prophets, what did he say about himself?

answers.text: He was the only one left
A few prophets were left with him
Only his servant was left with him

questions.question: Paul told the Romans that in his own time, as in Elijah's day, God had chosen what by grace?
